recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, close-up portrait of a man in urban attire, set against a dark, moody interior. The composition features a stark contrast between deep shadows and cool-toned highlights, with complex, distressed calligraphic typography layered in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's direct gaze creates a confrontational focal point
Diagonal lean of the subject balances the heavy typography block
Cool teal-blue ambient light contrasts with the stark white of the text
Texture of the subject's clothing and jewelry mirrors the distressed quality of the lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, leaning diagonally from bottom-left to center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large central initials in the typography block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the silver chain down to the hand, then moves up to the dense typographic cluster in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows in the upper left and background provide breathing room for the complex text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark teal (shadows and clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast; colors are muted to emphasize form and texture.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like red or orange
Limit to a monochromatic-adjacent cool palette

letterConstructionRules: Heavy use of flourishes and swashes
Distressed, weathered texture applied to all glyphs
Variable stroke weights with sharp, pointed terminals
Overlapping elements between lines of text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initials are oversized with ornate, thorny extensions
Ampersand is stylized to integrate with surrounding letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking ornate blackletter with a delicate, flowing script for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the gritty, urban gothic aesthetic
Provides the necessary flourishes and street-culture feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle cinematic portrait of a man with a goatee wearing a black durag and black sleeveless shirt, leaning back in a dark room. Lighting is cool-toned with teal shadows. He wears a heavy silver chain. The background is dark and out of focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a stacked block of distressed white blackletter typography in the top right corner. Use a large central initial pair with ornate flourishes. Add a line of delicate script below the main title. Apply a subtle grunge texture to all text.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a weathered, distressed appearance?
Is the typography the primary graphic element?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the teal color grade
Amount of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not look like a standard system font
Verify the cool-toned color balance is maintained
Check that the subject's gaze remains direct and impactful
Confirm the distressed texture is visible on the lettering
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle urban portrait with a cool-toned color grade and a dominant block of distressed, ornate blackletter typography placed in a corner of the frame.
